description: This is a PHP class implementation of a UserRepository that interacts with user data to authenticate users for OAuth2. It retrieves user entities based on credentials and integrates with the League\'s OAuth2 Server interfaces.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 UserRepositoryInterface to fetch user entities based on credentials, utilizing a BeanManager to access user data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserRepository with a BeanManager instance.

methods.name: getUserEntityByUserCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves a UserEntity for given username and password after validation, throwing exceptions if credentials are invalid.
